# Document 22 — Routing Simulation Results

**Generated by** `cargo run -p vl-sim --release` · seeds [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] (mean of 5 runs per cell)

> **These are simulation results, not Bluetooth measurements.** Mobility, encounter durations, goodput (20 kB/s assumed) and participation rates are modelling assumptions. Every node runs the production `vl-routing` engine with wire-encoded link messages; protocol caps (per-session 32 envelopes / 64 KiB, per-tag 8, carry cap 10 MiB) apply to every algorithm. Best-effort nodes model iPhones in background that complete a session in only a share of encounters.

Columns: delivery = share of messages reaching the recipient; ack = share whose sender obtained delivery proof (receipt or vaccine); p50/p90 = delivery latency in minutes; transfers/delivery = envelope transmissions (data + receipts) per delivered message; peak store = largest per-node store in KiB.

| spray L=8 | 0.99 | 0.98 | 419 | 1589 | 689 | 24.0 | 32 |
| epidemic | 0.91 | 0.91 | 235 | 460 | 409 | 69.8 | 56 |
